description: Recorded, reviewed-for-cause changes to windowChromeParity.baseline.json. Each entry is a key whose digest changed, the exact subcases that changed (all below the template; every at/above-template subcase of every key is byte-identical), the changed cells and the spec rows that cause them. Comparison basis: origin/v2 f35a8eaa composeWindowChrome vs the merged one, per subcase, placement segment field excluded; 2,208 subcases, 8 changed.

changes.cells: bottom edge: the code-10 cell (13 px at the template) drops to 0 px; the freed width goes to the code-14 cell (0 -> 2 px) and the cells after it shift. No other edge changes.
rules: compositor-spec.md, part-code classification row 10 and code 10 note: the too-short step (0x4dfe..0x4e0e) drops code 10 when the placed extent is below the fixed-cell sum (0x4a0c returns the too-short byte, read at 0x52fc); ledger evidence kdef.too-short-step
compositor-spec.md, Draw + distribution: the remainder is shared by 8/11/13/14/18 (0x5260..0x532e); ledger evidence kdef.width-allocation
qd-primitives.md W2: code 14 tiles in reverse (direction 0)
changes.source: main #377 (3d846c8e), merged into v2 at the 2026-10-22 sync
